reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: § 12.4 is a one-way covenant with a no-hire element ('solicit, hire, or employ'), covers all Vendor employees, runs 24 months, and negates unsolicited/general-advertising applications — hitting all three walk-away conditions and contradicting § 12.3.

The replacement text tracks the playbook fallback completely: mutual, solicitation-only (express 'no no-hire'), scoped to personnel directly involved in the Services, twelve (12) months from the end of that involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. Direction is correct (protects Customer) and the text is self-contained and actionable.
The failed 'duration ≤ 12 months' check appears to be a tokenizer false negative — the redline states 'twelve (12) months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement'.

The failed minimal-edit check (0.866 changed-character ratio) is justified here: every operative element of the original single-sentence clause (party scope, no-hire, employee scope, duration, carve-out negation) was non-compliant, so narrowing could not be achieved by surgical edits; the finding also expressly preserves deletion as the preferred ask.
Comment is concise, first-person plural, cites the playbook position and the § 12.3 inconsistency, and offers the preferred position as the fallback ask — consistent with tone requirements.

Minor, non-blocking: the replacement is somewhat wordier than necessary (e.g., the trailing 'whose employment ... has already ended' limb is optional); tightening would reduce negotiation surface but does not affect validity.
